checks: scene_id is unique across the manifest
scene_id and file path remain stable after publication
parent_scene_id exists in the manifest or is null
scene metadata and each referenced JSON file parse successfully
all referenced files exist
all files declare compatible schema versions
world coordinate convention and units have an authoritative source
local and world coordinates are not conflated
all active transforms specify axes, scale, rotation and translation
unknown values remain null or unverified
geometry features have stable IDs
dimensions are non-negative when supplied
doors and openings align with walkable/navigation data where applicable
scene entity IDs are unique within their namespace
references to existing ZHI agents/facilities use authoritative IDs
scene copies do not become alternate sources of truth for agent state
every edge references existing nodes
entrance and exit nodes reference valid place IDs where known
blocked areas are excluded from paths
routes do not connect across unverified coordinate systems
interaction targets exist or are explicitly pending
interaction ranges are non-negative
world actions match existing authorization and action contracts
a scene definition alone does not grant movement or interaction permission
all required integration checks pass
authoritative ZHI system remains the source of agent position and arrival status
review/approval is recorded before runtime integration

important_limits: This file specifies intended validation; it is not itself an executed validator.
Passing file validation does not prove that a scene has been deployed, rendered, or connected to the live ZHI world.
No database access or writes are authorized by this policy.
